Okay, so here's the plan for today. First I want Claude to look at the transcription path in WhisperBlow, because Apple's recognizer keeps mishearing names like Claude and Superbase. Then I want to bench a few newer models, maybe Parakeet, maybe Whisper, and see which one is fastest on my Mac. If one of them wins on both speed and accuracy, we swap it in. If not, we keep Apple and fix the dictionary instead. Either way, I want the numbers before we change anything.

So the bug report from yesterday was that the pill jumps when the dictation ends, and I think it is the panel resizing itself, not the Swift Uiframe. Can you open the pill demo file, run it with the left center anchor, and tell me how many points it moves? Then check the git log for the commit that changed the sizing options because I'm pretty sure that is where it started. Do not push anything yet, just tell me when you what you find and we will decide together on Slack with the Christian.
